item.title: [AI & I by Every] Why Every Traded Personal Agents for One Company Agent
item.description:
Speaker 1 | 00:00 - 00:12 The hot thing right now is dots. They're persistent agents from OpenAI. I was there at Dev Day when they launched them. I interviewed Sam about them, and I've been using dots since before they came out. And now we're into week two of dots.
Speaker 1 | 00:12 - 00:46 So how's it going? If you read my vibe check, you know that I thought they were a little bit rough to begin with, but that the idea of a persistent proactive agent was obviously the future. Even before DOTS ...
